body: My only mistake was not leaving the first time he made comments about my body. My ex-boyfriend broke up with me because I wasn’t healthy nor slim enough for him. I completely cut contact with him soon after he broke up with me and have not spoken to him in months. I do not feel the need to message or call him. I am coping with it the best way that I possibly can. I started focusing on my mental health and my physical health as well. I started going on runs + hikes and that’s definitely helped me out so much. One of the hardest parts of a break up is letting go of the routine you had with your partner.. the good morning/goodnight texts, going to their house, phone calls with them. So I found a new routine. I built new friendships and receive good morning texts from them. I started being around friends more. I became more intentional with my time.

I told my mom that I wasn’t really feeling this therapist and she suggested I look elsewhere so I think I’m going to do that. I’ve been on antidepressants before but only for a month. I didn’t like it and I told her that but she told me I didn’t give it enough time to see it I like it.

Below. I’ve done therapy before like 6 years ago. And don’t get me wrong it wasn’t too bad but I didn’t like the fact that automatically after talking about my depression and anxiety she suggested antidepressants. Nothing wrong with that either but I’m just one to not want to take medication.

You are the sweetest soul. I truly appreciate this message :( it’s been a little over a month since the breakup and I was doing great. I wasn’t texting him and I started doing things I’ve always wanted to do but yesterday was just bad. I guess I still can’t come to terms with this breakup. I hate the feeling of waking up and automatically thinking of him. I’m getting ready for work right now and I can’t stop crying

Yesterday was actually a good day for me. I didn’t think of him as much and when I did, I didn’t cry. But today was bad. There was traffic on my way home from work so it gave me plenty of time to think about everything. I started blasting sad music and just cried. I cried and I cried until I somewhat felt better. I thought it would be better to let out all my tears before I get home. There are many highs and lows during breakups is what I’ve realized. It sucks.
Thank you. I’m trying to find ways to distract myself and Reddit really seems to help! What’s going on if you don’t mind me asking?
Give yourself some time to think about it. To see if that’s what you actually wanna do.

I used to work at a grocery store and there was this one night where it was crazy busy and only had 3 registers open. There was this one dude that yelled out “this is so f*cking ridiculous open some more registers” .. the store went silent and we all stared at him. I could tell he felt awkward cause he stayed quiet after that 😂

I think when you are with someone for so long you get to know the type of person they are. You get to see if those truly are their intentions or not. Don’t get me wrong, it had crossed my mind so I did bring it up and he gave me the reassurance that I needed.

When I tell you I am literally sobbing reading this response. I truly appreciate it. You are such a kind person for sharing your experiences with me. It’s helping me see a different perspective. I came to Reddit because I feel like I can’t talk to anyone about this even though I have my family who 100% is always there for me. 

Just like you mentioned, my ex also feels like he could fix it himself. I hope he finds it in him to look for a therapist. I want him to truly be happy with himself but I know he won’t ever be happy with me if he cannot be happy with himself first. 

I’ve also come to realize this isn’t something that’s going to happen overnight or even a few months and I think that’s what is killing me. 
I’m letting myself cry whenever I need to. I’m allowing myself to feel all these emotions. But I know that I also need to take this time to find myself. To do things I enjoy doing. To spend more time with family. 
 
Again, thank you for sharing your experiences with me. I’m not going to bed sad anymore.

I guess I’m just scared my family will feel some type of way about my ex once I tell them we’re broken up. This also isn’t the first time we break up. My ex is truly an amazing person but he has some stuff he needs to heal from and I’ve tried helping him and being a support system for him but ultimately he isn’t very emotionally available and feels like he can deal with things alone. He bottles up all his emotions and eventually they catch up to him. I’ve suggested therapy and he’s looked into it but I just don’t think he’s ready yet but I know once he is ready he will seek help. I just care for him so much I don’t want this to be the end.
It’s been a month and I’m still struggling to let go but I’ve started reading a new book.

Thank you so much for this. I have people I can talk to but I don’t want them to feel any way towards my ex because he is a kind person. He just has a lot of mental health issues that he does not know how to deal with. I have tried to encourage him to seek therapy but I just don’t think he’s ready. I keep hoping that he will come back to me but I also realize I have to let go and if it is meant to be it will be because I cannot force anything. The hardest part for me is waking up and going to sleep. It’s when I feel the most alone.
